title: Basilica of San Francisco, La Paz
geometryBasis: Named church and tower outlines, native facade endpoints and adjacent public pavement define the exterior location and plan.
sectionBasis: The dated stereograph establishes the richly carved portal, crest and paired arches on each of the belfry stages. The conservation and university studies document the stonework, central crossing dome and one later stone tower.
limitations: The modeled subject is the mapped church and single attached bell tower. The former convent, museum buildings and interiors are outside this model.
Carved iconography, side elevations and the precise belfry height are approximated using the dated photograph and architectural documentation.
